instrument_name: Iowa Code 91A.6 Notice and recordkeeping requirements
figure_or_rule_carried: Subsec 4: on each regular payday employer provides statement showing hours worked, wages earned and deductions made, delivered by mail, secure electronic means, at the workplace, or by access to view; subsec 3: within 10 working days of employee request a written itemized statement of earnings and deductions with explanation of computation; subsec 1(d): payroll records kept 3 calendar years. Subsec 1 duties are triggered by director notice after a paid claim or civil penalty.

instrument_name: Iowa DOR 1040 expanded instructions Line 19 School District Surtax / EMS Tax
figure_or_rule_carried: School district surtax and EMS surtax are computed on the individual return (Iowa Code 422.5 tax less nonrefundable credits, times surtax rate) by school district of residence on the last day of the tax year (2025 return); EMS surtax only in Appanoose, Cass, Pocahontas, Sac, Shelby and Winnebago counties. Page makes no mention of employer withholding of either surtax. No city or county wage tax located.

instrument_name: Utah Pub 14 Withholding Tax Guide Rev. 04/26 (re-read for parts 1 and 5)
figure_or_rule_carried: Schedules multiply Utah taxable wages by .0445 (4.45%) less an allowance phased out at 1.3% of wages above $180 (single) or $360 (married) on the weekly schedule (base allowance 9 single / 19 married); based on federal W-4, no subtraction for W-4 allowances; returns electronic. Supplemental-wage rate and rounding rule not found in the Pub 14 copy read. Effective date of 4.45% rests on US-UT-PIT-004 (search summary, unverified).

instrument_name: Utah Pub 14 Rev. 04/26 - nonresidents working temporarily in Utah; residents working outside Utah
article_or_section: Employee Withholding Exclusions; Who must withhold
figure_or_rule_carried: Do not withhold Utah tax for a nonresident employee who has no other Utah-source income, works in Utah 20 days or less, and is resident of a state with no income tax or a similar exclusion (Utah Code 59-10-402, 59-10-117.5); not for professional athletes, entertainers, prominent persons; withhold on Utah-resident wages for work outside Utah but Utah tax may be reduced by tax withheld by the other state; employer exemption if business in Utah 60 days or less with Commission approval (59-10-402(2)). Pub 14 lists no reciprocal agreements.

instrument_name: Utah DWS UI tax rates page (copy 2026-06-11) - surcharge and social cost

instrument_name: Packet OW-2 (Rev. 11-2025) General Information - 68 O.S. 2385.1 exclusions (re-read)
figure_or_rule_carried: Withholding applies to everyone paid for services rendered in Oklahoma except 68 O.S. 2385.1 exclusions, incl. instrument_name: Arkansas DFA Withholding Tax Employer's Instructions (Effective 01/01/2026, Revised 4/27/26)
authority: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration
article_or_section: Introduction; Supplemental Wages; Nonresident Employees; Texarkana Residents
figure_or_rule_carried: Current withholding tax rate 3.7%; supplemental wages (bonus, commission, overtime paid with regular wages): deduct 3.7% of the payment; AR4EC exemption certificate; nonresident employees: withhold on wages for services performed in Arkansas, apportioned by working days when partly outside; Texarkana border-city exemption (Ark. Code 26-52-604) for residents of Texarkana AR and TX on wages earned in Texarkana AR (forms AR-TX, AR-3Q-TEX); employer remains liable even if a third party files; ATAP portal. Guide names no local income tax and no reciprocal agreement.

instrument_name: Mississippi Code 71-5-353(4) taxable wages (MDES Employment Security Law, 2024-02-15 copy)
figure_or_rule_carried: Taxable wages exclude remuneration above $14,000 per employee per calendar year ($7,000 through 2010-12-31); standard rate 5.4%; newly subject employer 1.0% first year, 1.1% second, 1.2% third and later (until experience-rated). Copy dated 2024-02-15; later amendments not checked.

instrument_name: MDES Unemployment Tax Rates page and Form UI-2/3 instructions
figure_or_rule_carried: New employers 1.00% / 1.10% / 1.20% (years 1 / 2 / 3+); experience rates 0.0%-5.4%; rates exclude the Workforce Investment and Training contribution; taxable wage base $14,000 (UI-2/3 header and Item 6); MDES page states UI tax is paid by the employer (no employee contribution).

instrument_name: Mississippi Code 71-5-353 Workforce Investment and Training contributions
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer-paid Workforce Enhancement Training + Office of Workforce Development + Mississippi Works contributions for calendar years after 2016 at 0.20% of taxable wages (0.15% WET, 0.01% OWD, 0.04% Mississippi Works); Mississippi Works 0.04% only in years when the general experience rate is below 0.2%; suspension provisions apply; added to the UI rate. 2026 applicability not confirmed on a 2026 primary page (MDES page says it "might be applicable for the rate year").
